method: Sequential OpenCV read() decoding; frames 0,20,...,1040 inspected visually on native-width contact sheets and enlarged crops. No detector outputs, segmentation, tracking, or interpolated labels used. Coordinates manually transcribed by assistant.
coordinates: Original 1280x720 frame pixels; zero-based x right, y down; frame indices zero-based sequential decoded order.
timing_note: Container metadata conflicts with actual decode. User-provided 29.8 FPS is not independently measured here. No timestamp-based seeking used.
tolerance_note: 6 px is approximate visual annotation tolerance, not an empirically validated error bound. Partial occlusion prevents observing full silhouette.

status_definitions.visible: Enough arc visible to estimate horizontal center; may be partially occluded.
status_definitions.uncertain: Ball-like evidence but center not reliable; x null.
status_definitions.occluded: Known ball location hidden and center not visually recoverable; x null.
status_definitions.not_visible: No identifiable ball in inspected frame; x null.

temporary_roi_anchors.scope: Frame 1040 only (last sampled frame), temporary ROI placement only. Camera perspective and ruler motion preclude reuse as global metric calibration.
temporary_roi_anchors.note: x marks long centimeter tick, not printed numeral center; y is visible top boundary at that tick.

visible_upper_boundary.identity: ruler top edge / occlusion boundary, NOT independently verified physical rail edge
visible_upper_boundary.note: Boundary is sloped/curved; one horizontal y does not describe entire ROI.

physical_upper_rail.note: Mechanical upper rail is not separately identifiable behind ruler. Do not substitute visible ruler boundary as measured physical rail.

ruler_reference_frame0.scope: Frame 0 only; manually reread from frame 0, not reused or shifted from frame 1040. ROI-only temporary anchors.
ruler_reference_frame0.coordinate_definition: Original full-frame pixels. x is long centimeter tick; y is visible ruler top edge at that tick (top of tick), not printed numeral or ruler bottom edge.
ruler_reference_frame0.note: Separate-agent visual audit, not human-independent ground truth. Approximate tolerance; physical upper rail remains obscured.

ruler_upper_edge_samples.identity: Visible ruler top boundary, not ruler lower edge or independently observed mechanical rail.
ruler_upper_edge_samples.coordinates: Original 1280x720 frame pixels; y increases downward. x values also read per frame to follow moving centimeter ticks.
ruler_upper_edge_samples.method: Assistant visually inspected all 53 three-panel coordinate-grid contact rows and transcribed 159 upper-edge points. No automated edge detection, segmentation, detector output, interpolation, or reuse of frame-1040 anchors.
ruler_upper_edge_samples.tolerance_note: Approximate visual tolerance, not validated measurement uncertainty. Lower-edge coordinates were not measured in this addition.

frame0_confirmation.method: Reinspected clean frame-0 crop and enlarged long centimeter ticks; original visual readings retained. Compared draft only after original annotations existed.
frame0_confirmation.recommendation: For temporary ROI config, use frame-0 tick x values 229,319,614,929,1038. Draft 12cm/17cm agree within 3px; draft 5cm/7cm/19cm lie 6,6,7px to the right of confirmed long ticks.

priority_reference_audit.limitations: Visible ruler upper boundary only. Separate-agent visual audit; not human GT. Calibration not valid. Detection numbers supplied by user for comparison only; no detector outputs read or used to revise manual labels. All prior ball and ruler annotations unchanged.
